study_identification_part.si_4_title: Investigating dopaminergic abnormalities in schizophrenia and first-episode psychosis with normative modelling and multisite molecular neuroimaging

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: [11C]-(+)-PHNO datasets from Invicro (Single-site, two scanners: PET/CT and PET/MR); [18F]FDOPA datasets from Invicro, MRC Cyclotron Unit, and Bundang Hospital (Multi-site, five scanners). Specific internal identifiers: PHNO_HC01, PHNO_HC02, FDOPA_HC01, FDOPA_HC02, FDOPA_01, FDOPA_02, FDOPA_03, FDOPA_04.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Data were acquired with five different scanners (Siemens Hi-Rez Biograph 6, Siemens Biograph 40 TruePoint, Siemens TruePoint 6, ECAT HR + 962, and ECAT EXACT 3D) in three different imaging sites (MRC Cyclotron Unit, London; Invicro, London and Bundang Hospital, South Korea).

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: PHNO data were used to identify the optimal harmonisation method (Gaussian smoothing vs. Combat). FDOPA healthy control (HC) data from five sources were pooled to train the normative model using 5-fold cross-validation. FDOPA patient data (both matched and independent cohorts) were used to investigate patterns of deviation and clinical associations.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: In the first section, we used two datasets [40, 41] of [11C]-(+)-PHNO... to compare the effects of two image harmonisation methods... In the second section, we used the estimated [18F]FDOPA PET model to calculate the deviations from normality in four datasets... acquired in patients.

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Model-1 (PHNO) established using 77 healthy controls from two studies. Model-2 (FDOPA) established using a reference cohort of 142 healthy controls pooled from five datasets. For both, training was performed using k-fold cross-validation (k=5), so a single training set size is not specified.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: For model-1, weighted mean and pooled SD calculated from PET/CT (n=54, mean=26.52, sd=7.87) and PET/MR (n=23, mean=24.39, sd=4.90). For model-2, weighted mean and pooled SD calculated from five HC datasets (FDOPA_01: n=61, 26.25 [5.18]; FDOPA_02: n=26, 29.00 [8.70]; FDOPA_03: n=12, 44.52 [9.97]; FDOPA_HC01: n=36, 30.63 [10.91]; FDOPA_HC02: n=7, 24.43 [4.65]).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: For model-1, summed directly from Table 1: PET/CT (22F/32M) and PET/MR (12F/11M). For model-2, female N estimated for matched HC groups by applying the dataset-level female percentage to the HC N (FDOPA_01: 61*36.7%≈22; FDOPA_02: 26*34.0%≈9; FDOPA_03: 12*58.8%≈7), plus HC-only datasets (FDOPA_HC01: 14F/22M; FDOPA_HC02: 1F/6M). Total F = 22+9+7+14+1 = 53.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Table 1 reports sex info: PHNO (22F/32M and 12F/11M). FDOPA (32F/55M, 17F/33M, 21F/13M, 8F/28M, 14F/22M, 1F/6M).
